'''Ebony Gatekeeper''' is an NPC in [[Somnoire]] that first appears in the [[Depths of Illusive Realm]] event and the enemy of the [[Ivory Gatekeeper]].

In the Depths of Illusive Realm, the Ebony Gatekeeper allows players to exchange Dream Fragments for Metaphors upon entering a Memory of Rest. The Ebony Gatekeeper says his role in the [[Somnoire]] is to erase dreams, maintaining the Somnoire's<ref>[[Somnoire]], an unknown realm of collective dreams, is used to find the answer to vanquishing [[The Lament]].</ref> dream capacity.

During [[Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways]], it is revealed that he was the one taking on the identity of Cosmos and Dorothy in [[Fairy Tale's Finale]].
